description: A cross-platform educational graphics library with enhanced drawing primitives, text rendering, collision detection, game development, and advanced visual effects.
releaseNotes:
Version 1.4.0:
			- FIX: Creating a second CPDrawer now actually works (new window replaces the old
			  one); the constructor fails loudly if the window cannot be created
			- FIX: AddRegularPolygon fills its interior as a single removable shape
			- FIX: AddTextAligned aligns exactly; AddTextWrapped wraps with real text widths
			- FIX: Custom fonts loaded with LoadFontFromFile now render in text shapes
			- FIX: Gradients follow the drawn geometry under Scale; Opacity clamps to 0..1
			- FIX: Rotated image bounds cover the true AABB (collision near corners)
			- FIX: Right-click while holding left no longer reports as a left click
			- NEW: DashStyle on lines (CLine.DashStyle)
			- PERF: One-copy frame presentation (ReadPixels); BGRA back-buffer; cached dash
			  effects; missing-image lookups cached
			- DEPS: Avalonia 11.3.17, SkiaSharp 2.88.9

			Version 1.3.2:
			- FIX: Pie slices fill as true wedges (previously only the chord segment filled)
			- FIX: Thread safety between student code and the render loop (shape list + back-buffer)
			- FIX: ClearImageCache no longer breaks images still on screen
			- FIX: Background-image swaps no longer race the render thread
			- FIX: Held keys release when the window loses focus (no more stuck keys after alt-tab)
			- FIX: SetBBScaledPixel places cells accurately with fractional Scale values
			- FIX: Float-overload AddArc no longer truncates thickness to int
			- FIX: Removed per-frame console output when shadows are enabled
			- PERF: Typefaces cached per (family, bold, italic) instead of resolved every frame
			- DOCS: Corrected AddArc/AddPie angle docs (0 deg = up, clockwise)

			Version 1.3.1:
			- NEW: Turtle graphics (Logo-style Forward/Backward/Turn/PenUp/PenDown/MoveTo)
			- NEW: OnFrame event (~60fps library-driven animation loop)
			- NEW: SaveImage synchronous PNG export; Remove(shape); Width/Height properties
			- FIX: Text-box overloads now word-wrap inside their rectangle
			- FIX: Linux runtime support via SkiaSharp.NativeAssets.Linux
			- TEST: Added a headless test suite (turtle, pixel colour, rendering)

			Version 1.3.0:
			- VISUAL: Linear gradient fills for all shapes with customizable angles
			- VISUAL: Dash/dot stroke styles for borders and lines (Solid, Dash, Dot, DashDot, DashDotDot)
			- ARCHITECTURE: Shape grouping (CGroup) with composite pattern for complex objects
			- Group management methods: AddGroup(), GetLastGroup()
			- Gradient helper methods: SetLinearGradient(), ClearGradient()

			Version 1.2.0:
			- PERFORMANCE: Massive rendering optimization (10-100x faster)
			- MEMORY: Auto-dispose singleton to prevent crashes
			- GAME DEV: Collision detection, sprite sheets, input polling
			- INPUT: Scroll wheel support
